channel.title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK vs the World
channel.desc: The fierce Drag Race UK spin-off continues as our international queens fight to impress Mama Ru and do their countries proud. Silence is golden as the queens tackle an acting challenge with a difference. Split into two teams, the queens must let their bodies do the talking as they star in silent movies, with direction from Doctor Who supremo Russell T Davies. Acting superstar Will Poulter joins RuPaul on the judging panel alongside Michelle Visage and Alan Carr. May the best drag queen win!
